name: jev-guard
description: Score proposed actions against your rules and compare final claims with turn evidence. Calls are allowed through if the external scorer is unavailable.
sourceDescription: Probability-scored guardrails for Claude Code: deny rule-breaking edits and unasked-for deploys, route your own docs into each prompt, and check the final answer against the turn's own evidence.
author: Oguzhan Cakmak

category.basis: Checks commands, permissions, privacy or rules before actions.
